nodes.description: Public boolean state variable acting as a one-time execution guard for the spell.
Constant string describing the Tinlake CF4 Mainnet Spell - 3.
Constant address of the Tinlake root contract (0x4B6CA198d257D755A5275648D471FE09931b764A).
Constant address of the NAV feed contract (0xcAB9ed8e5EF4607A97f4e22Ad1D984ADB93ce890).
Constant uint256 scaling factor 10**27 used for risk group ratios.
Address state variable set to address(this) so the spell can be relied on the root contract.
Public entry point guarded by the done flag; marks the spell cast and invokes execute().
Internal function that relies the spell on the root and files new risk groups on the NAV feed.
Local TinlakeRootLike instance bound to the ROOT constant address.
Local NAVFeedLike instance bound to the NAV_FEED constant address.
External call root.relyContract(NAV_FEED, self) granting the spell privileged access on the NAV feed.
External calls navFeed.file(...) writing new risk group parameters (groups 6-10).

edges.reason: cast() reads and writes the done guard before executing, providing reentrancy protection context.
cast() invokes execute() after setting the done flag.
execute() assigns the ROOT constant into the root local variable.
execute() assigns the NAV_FEED constant into the navFeed local variable.
execute() sets self = address(this) stored in state.
ROOT constant address flows into the root local variable.
NAV_FEED constant address flows into the navFeed local variable.
root local is the receiver of the privileged relyContract call.
self address is passed as the authorized contract in relyContract.
NAV_FEED address is passed to relyContract to determine which contract gets the new privilege.
navFeed local is the receiver of the file(...) risk group writes.
ONE constant feeds ratio arguments in the risk group file calls.

normalization_plan.reason: Temporary local alias for the ROOT constant created inside execute(); it carries no independent state and only feeds the relyContract unsafe operation.
Temporary local alias for the NAV_FEED constant created inside execute(); it carries no independent state and only feeds the file(...) risk group calls.
